title: Goodobbies Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Goodobbies, stunning renovation in Seaside, FL! This luxury residence has two king bedrooms and is only 118 feet from the private beach access at Savannah Street Pavilion. Wonderful porches, lovely interior, king primary, and more!
description_expanded: Description21 SAVANNAH STREET2 KINGS, BUNK ROOM (2 twin bunks)- Sleeps 8 and Pet Friendly!Welcome to Goodobbies in Seaside, FloridaWelcome to Goodobbies, an elegant coastal retreat nestled in the heart of Seaside, Florida. This beautifully designed three-bedroom, three-bath home—never before rented—offers a refined yet relaxed atmosphere just 118 feet from the beach. Thoughtfully curated for families and groups of up to eight guests, Goodobbies blends classic Seaside charm with elevated comfort, creating the perfect setting for unforgettable beachside memories.Outdoor Living & Coastal ComfortFrom the moment you arrive, you’re welcomed by a spacious wraparound screened porch, thoughtfully furnished with multiple seating areas and an outdoor dining space ideal for morning coffee or evening conversations. This inviting outdoor extension sets the tone for laid-back coastal living and seamless indoor-outdoor flow.Main Living SpacesInside, the first floor opens to a bright and expansive living area designed for gathering and relaxation. Two plush sofas surround a large flat-screen TV, making it an ideal space for movie nights, game nights, or unwinding after a day at the beach. Adjacent is a generous dining area with seating for ten—perfect for shared meals or casual breakfasts before heading out for the day.The adjacent media and entertaining area features a large plasma TV, Sonos sound bar, and a bar nook complete with a beverage refrigerator. Just beyond, the beautifully renovated kitchen is a chef’s dream, equipped with top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances including a four-burner gas range with griddle, a Sub-Zero refrigerator, and an additional dining nook with seating for five.First-Floor BedroomsThe first floor offers two thoughtfully designed bedrooms. The bunk room, a favorite for families, sleeps four with two twin bunk beds and includes a workspace, ample custom storage, and a large flat-screen TV. A full bathroom with walk-in shower and single vanity is conveniently located nearby.Across the hall, the second bedroom features a king bed, a cozy sitting area, workspace, and a private ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower and single vanity—ideal for guests seeking comfort and privacy.Primary Suite RetreatThe entire second floor is dedicated to the luxurious primary suite, offering a true retreat experience. This serene space includes a plush king bed, a spa-inspired ensuite bathroom with soaking tub, separate shower, and dual vanities, creating a peaceful sanctuary after a day in the sun.Tower Views & Outdoor SpacesA hidden gem of the home is the third-level enclosed tower, where guests can enjoy panoramic views of Seaside and the Gulf of Mexico. Whether reading a book, sipping a cocktail, or watching the sunset, this space offers a truly special vantage point.At the rear of the home, an open-air dining deck comfortably seats up to ten—perfect for al fresco dinners and evening gatherings. Additional conveniences include an outdoor shower and a full laundry room with washer and dryer on the main level.A True Seaside EscapeWith its unbeatable location near the beach, thoughtful design, and elevated amenities, Goodobbies offers a refined yet relaxed Seaside experience. Whether you’re gathering with family, entertaining friends, or simply soaking in the coastal charm, this home is the perfect setting for your next Florida getaway.For those needing extra space, there is a guest house on the property available for rent. Check out "Sunsets on Savannah," which accommodates four more guests. Experience the magic of Seaside, FL, in this unique beach bungalow!* 5-night minimum Summer, Spring & Spring Break, 3 night minimum Fall, 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration.* Pets are allowed with certain restrictions and provisions. An additional $100 per day rental pet fee will be collected in addition to the flat $150 pet fee for three-bedroom homes. Pets will not be allowed on furniture. No dog over 70 lbs. * Please note that the private driveway on the property is reserved exclusively for guests of Sunsets on Savannah.FEATURES1,576 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceJust 118 feet to private beach access at Savannah PavilionSeaside offers the largest private residential beach on 30ATesla Universal Wall Connector available for guest usePlasma TVs throughout the home and a Sonos sound bar in the main living areaOutdoor dining area for relaxed coastal mealsOutdoor fireplace is decorative only and not available for guest useAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickle ball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, including starter amenitiesTwo parking passes provided for two-bedroom and larger homesPlease note: A golf cart is considered a vehicle. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit.Pet-friendly
